review_evidence: Reviewed all 33 primary Lean files. The repository is a large theorem-rich many-sorted logic/model-theory development covering languages, formulas, homomorphisms, substructures, quotients, partial types and related constructions.

The Examples/ files were inspected by role and contain substantive formal structures/terms/theorems for groups, rings, fields, orders, valued fields and related examples; they are retained rather than filtered by path. The root import surface is also retained.
summary: Reviewed Many-sorted-model-theory and retained the complete formal logic/model-theory corpus, including substantive examples.
